readerCopy.body: It may be surprisingly easy to stop doing something you once thought was permanent. Uranus trine the South Node can loosen an old routine, attachment, identity, or expectation without requiring a dramatic confrontation. A new option may make the old pattern irrelevant almost overnight. Let the ease help. You do not need to manufacture a crisis to justify leaving something that has simply run its course.
